summary.en: Founded in early 2022 by IC Chan (a Berkeley SkyDeck startup advisor) and VC lawyer Bryan Huang, TGA is a US-Taiwan angel club (~50 members) that invests in Silicon Valley startups through US LLCs/SPVs — a more institutionalized model than typical Taiwan angel clubs.
